other_conditions: The awardee must be a highly qualified superannuated professional in his/her field.
The awardee should be an acknowledged leader (expert) in the specific field of specialization with active engagement in research and development.
The awardee must have contributed to societal development through excellent fieldwork.
Nominations are required and can be submitted any time of the year to the designated address.
benefits_summary: Provides an honorarium of Rs 10,000 per day (up to five days per trip) plus travel expenses, and allows up to five online sessions of 2 hours each with additional interaction time.
